create_tree_manager: create a TreeManager instance to maintain tree-structured input data for expression simplification
create_tree_node: create a tree node with a root value, parent index, depth, and optional state tensor
clone_tree_manager: clone an existing TreeManager to create a deep copy of all trees and their structure
find_subtree: find a subtree matching a given expression within a tree using addition or subtraction operations
to_string_tree: convert a tree node to its string representation with optional token mapping support
